# `/mongo-data-safety`

Use when reading or writing MongoDB documents in a multi-tenant, schemaless codebase — covers the tenant filter every query must carry, strict:false silent-write drift, raw-driver bypass, distinct-before-branch, and plural/silent-create collection traps.

## Cách gọi

```text
/mongo-data-safety
```

## Tool được phép

`Read Grep Glob Bash`
